subject: freeDictIfNeeded when kvstoreEmpty (#13098)
reason: The added freeDictIfNeeded() call in kvstoreEmpty() is unreachable with effect in this checkout: freeDictIfNeeded is a no-op unless the kvstore has KVSTORE_FREE_EMPTY_DICTS, the only kvstores ever passed to kvstoreEmpty are db->keys/db->expires (db.c:498-499) which are always created without that flag (server.c:2661, db.c:570, lazyfree.c:181), and the only flagged kvstore, pubsubshard_channels (server.c:2679), is never emptied via kvstoreEmpty — its per-channel deletes already freed empty dicts before this change (kvstore.c:799). Both builds therefore behave identically on every reachable path
